title: Bait
content:
# Bait

# Introduction

Bait is a type of item used for fishing. A bait can be attached to a Fishing rod by equipping the fishing rod and then right-clicking the bait in the inventory. Depending on the bait attached to a fishing rod, different types of fish can be caught.

## Obtaining

The basic fishing bait can be purchased from Haldor. More advanced baits can be crafted at a Food preparation table by combining 20 of the basic bait with a trophy to produce 20 advanced baits.
Two and four regular fishing bait may also be obtained from the pickable fishing rod, which can be found in the rare room with a large frozen lake inside Frost Caves.

## Types

All baits weigh 0.1 and stack to 100.

• Bait: Fishing bait | Requires (per 20): 10 Coins | Attracts: Perch, Pike | Biome: Meadows, Black Forest

• Bait: Mossy fishing bait | Requires (per 20): Troll trophy | Attracts: Trollfish | Biome: Black Forest

• Bait: Sticky fishing bait | Requires (per 20): Abomination Trophy | Attracts: Giant herring | Biome: Swamp

• Bait: Stingy fishing bait | Requires (per 20): Fuling trophy | Attracts: Grouper | Biome: Plains

• Bait: Heavy fishing bait | Requires (per 20): Serpent trophy | Attracts: Tuna, Coral cod | Biome: Ocean

• Bait: Misty fishing bait | Requires (per 20): Lox trophy | Attracts: Pufferfish, Anglerfish | Biome: Mistlands

• Bait: Hot fishing bait | Requires (per 20): Warrior trophy | Attracts: Magmafish | Biome: Ashlands

• Bait: Frosty fishing bait | Requires (per 20): Drake trophy | Attracts: Northern salmon | Biome: Deep North

• Bait: Cold fishing bait | Requires (per 20): Fenring trophy | Attracts: Pike, Tetra | Biome: Meadows & Black Forest (Pike), Frost Caves (Tetra)
